knowledge.title: Penanganan Gejala Flu Awal pada Dewasa
knowledge.topic_keywords: flu, pilek, influenza, batuk ringan, bersin, hidung tersumbat, gejala flu awal, mengatasi flu, masuk angin, hidung mampet, tenggorokan gatal
knowledge.short_answer: Untuk gejala flu ringan pada tahap awal, penanganan mandiri yang tepat meliputi istirahat optimal, pemenuhan hidrasi tubuh yang cukup, dan menjaga kehangatan saluran napas.
knowledge.important_points: ["Istirahat total dan tidur yang cukup (7-9 jam per hari) guna membantu imunitas tubuh melawan virus.","Perbanyak minum air hangat minimal 2-2.5 liter per hari untuk mengencerkan lendir dan mencegah dehidrasi.","Konsumsi makanan bernutrisi tinggi dan sup hangat serta vitamin C atau buah-buahan segar.","Gunakan uap air hangat atau bilas hidung dengan larutan saline (garam fisiologis) jika hidung tersumbat."]
knowledge.when_to_see_doctor: Segera konsultasikan ke dokter apabila demam melebihi 38.5°C selama lebih dari 3 hari, timbul sesak napas berat, nyeri dada, batuk berdahak kuning-kehijauan kental, atau kondisi memburuk setelah 7 hari.
knowledge.content_full: Panduan klinis tata laksana influenza ringan mengutamakan terapi suportif karena flu disebabkan oleh virus yang bersifat self-limiting. Antibiotik tidak diperlukan kecuali terdapat indikasi infeksi bakteri sekunder yang telah diperiksa oleh dokter.

knowledge.title: Penyebab dan Pertolongan Pertama Demam pada Dewasa
knowledge.topic_keywords: demam, panas badan, suhu tinggi, menggigil, badan panas, penyebab demam, mengatasi demam, paracetamol, demam tinggi, meriang, kapan ke dokter
knowledge.short_answer: Demam adalah respon fisiologis sistem kekebalan tubuh dalam melawan infeksi virus, bakteri, atau peradangan. Suhu tubuh normal berkisar antara 36.5°C - 37.5°C.
knowledge.important_points: ["Ukur suhu secara berkala dengan termometer medis yang akurat (demam jika suhu di atas 38°C).","Kompres dengan air hangat (bukan air es) di area dahi, ketiak, atau lipatan paha.","Minum cairan yang cukup untuk mencegah dehidrasi akibat penguapan tubuh.","Kenakan pakaian yang longgar dan menyerap keringat di ruangan bersirkulasi baik.","Dapat meminum obat penurun panas (seperti Paracetamol) sesuai dosis anjuran kemasan jika merasa tidak nyaman."]
knowledge.when_to_see_doctor: Kunjungi fasilitas kesehatan jika suhu tubuh di atas 39°C, demam berlanjut lebih dari 3 hari, timbul ruam kemerahan, kaku pada leher, kejang, muntah terus menerus, atau pasien mengalami penurunan kesadaran.
knowledge.content_full: Demam bukan merupakan penyakit tersendiri, melainkan gejala dari suatu proses infeksi atau reaksi imunologis tubuh.

knowledge.title: Langkah Penanganan Sakit Kepala Tegang (Tension Headache)
knowledge.topic_keywords: sakit kepala, pusing, kepala tegang, puyeng, sakit kepala belakang, migrain, stres, kaku leher, kepala berdenyut, sakit kepala sebelah
knowledge.short_answer: Sakit kepala tipe tegang umumnya dipicu oleh stres fisik atau emosional, kelelahan mata, kurang tidur, dehidrasi, atau postur tubuh yang kaku saat bekerja.
knowledge.important_points: ["Istirahatkan mata dan hindari paparan layar gadget (screen time) selama minimal 30 menit.","Lakukan relaksasi dan pijat lembut di area pelipis, tengkuk leher, dan bahu.","Pastikan tubuh terhidrasi dengan meminum segelas air putih hangat.","Lakukan peregangan otot leher secara perlahan dan atur pernapasan secara teratur."]
knowledge.when_to_see_doctor: Segera ke IGD atau dokter spesialis saraf jika sakit kepala muncul sangat mendadak dan hebat (thunderclap headache), disertai gangguan penglihatan, kelemahan separuh badan, bicara pelo, atau setelah mengalami benturan kepala.
knowledge.content_full: Sebagian besar sakit kepala tegang merespon baik terhadap modifikasi gaya hidup, manajemen stres, dan analgesik ringan lini pertama jika diperlukan.

knowledge.title: Gejala dan Pencegahan Anemia Defisiensi Besi
knowledge.topic_keywords: anemia, kurang darah, hb rendah, hemoglobin, pucat, lemas, 5l, mudah lelah, pusing saat berdiri, ujung jari dingin, sesak saat aktivitas
knowledge.short_answer: Anemia adalah kondisi ketika kadar hemoglobin (Hb) dalam sel darah merah berada di bawah standar normal, mengakibatkan pasokan oksigen ke seluruh jaringan tubuh menurun.
knowledge.important_points: ["Gejala khas 5L: Lemah, Letih, Lesu, Lelah, dan Lunglai serta tampak pucat pada kelopak mata bawah atau kuku.","Konsumsi makanan kaya zat besi seperti daging merah tanpa lemak, hati ayam/sapi, bayam, brokoli, dan kacang-kacangan.","Kombinasikan dengan makanan kaya vitamin C (jeruk, jambu biji) untuk membantu penyerapan zat besi optimal di usus.","Hindari minum teh atau kopi secara bersamaan saat makan makanan berzat besi tinggi karena tanin menghambat penyerapan."]
knowledge.when_to_see_doctor: Konsultasikan ke dokter untuk pemeriksaan darah lengkap (Hb, Ferritin, TIBC) jika sering mengalami pusing berputar, jantung berdebar-debar tanpa sebab jelas, sesak napas saat aktivitas ringan, atau pingsan.
knowledge.content_full: Penegakan diagnosis pasti anemia memerlukan konfirmasi laboratorium hemoglobin darah.

knowledge.title: Pertolongan Awal Sakit Maag dan Asam Lambung (Gastritis/GERD)
knowledge.topic_keywords: maag, asam lambung, gerd, nyeri ulu hati, perut perih, kembung, mual, heartburn, lambung sakit, perih lambung, begah
knowledge.short_answer: Sakit maag (dispepsia) atau refluks asam lambung terjadi akibat iritasi pada dinding lambung atau naiknya asam lambung ke kerongkongan.
knowledge.important_points: ["Makan dalam porsi kecil namun lebih sering (small frequent meals) setiap 3-4 jam.","Hindari makanan yang terlalu pedas, sangat asam, berlemak tinggi, minuman bersoda, kopi, dan alkohol.","Jangan langsung berbaring atau tidur setidaknya 2-3 jam setelah makan.","Tinggikan posisi bantal saat tidur jika merasakan sensasi panas di dada (heartburn).","Dapat mengonsumsi antasida sesuai petunjuk kemasan untuk meredakan keasaman lambung sementara."]
knowledge.when_to_see_doctor: Segera periksakan ke dokter jika terdapat muntah berwarna hitam atau bercak darah, BAB berwarna hitam pekat (melena), penurunan berat badan drastis tanpa sebab, atau nyeri ulu hati tembus ke punggung.
knowledge.content_full: Pencegahan kekambuhan maag sangat bergantung pada pola makan teratur dan pengelolaan stres.

knowledge.content_full:
Judul: Tata Laksana Terkini Hipertensi Primer pada Layanan Kesehatan Primer
Penerbit: Perhimpunan Dokter Spesialis Kardiovaskular Indonesia (PERKI)
Tahun: 2024
Kata Kunci: hipertensi, tekanan darah tinggi, tensi, kardiovaskular, diet rendah garam
Pertanyaan: Bagaimana langkah penanganan awal hipertensi stadium 1?

Ringkasan:
Hipertensi stadium 1 (tekanan darah sistolik 130-139 mmHg atau diastolik 80-89 mmHg) pada tahap awal diprioritaskan untuk modifikasi gaya hidup sehat selama 3 hingga 6 bulan sebelum terapi medikamentosa.

Hal Penting:
• Batasi asupan natrium / garam maksimal 1 sendok teh (kurang dari 2 gram natrium) per hari.
• Lakukan aktivitas fisik aerobik intensitas sedang 150 menit per minggu (misal: jalan cepat, berenang).
• Terapkan pola makan DASH yang kaya sayuran, buah, dan biji-bijian serta rendah lemak jenuh.
• Hentikan kebiasaan merokok dan batasi konsumsi kafein berlebihan.

Kapan Perlu ke Dokter:
Segera ke fasilitas gawat darurat apabila tekanan darah mencapai > 180/120 mmHg (Krisis Hipertensi) atau disertai gejala nyeri dada hebat, sesak napas berat, sakit kepala luar biasa, dan pandangan kabur.

Medical Journal of Indonesia
Pulmonary  tuberculosis  and  fungal  coinfection  during  2018–2022:  a  single  center  
study in Jakarta, Indonesia
Ariyani Kiranasari, Yeva Rosana, Conny Riana Tjampakasari, Ika Ningsih
Basic Medical Research
ABSTRACT
BACKGROUND Pulmonary  tuberculosis  (TB)  is  among  the  top  10  causes  of  death  
worldwide. Prolonged use and noncompliance with TB treatment have a potential risk 
for  pulmonary  fungal  coinfection.  This  study  aimed  to  evaluate  fungal  coinfection  in  
pulmonary  TB  patients  in  Indonesia  referred  to  the  Clinical  Microbiology  Laboratory,  
Faculty of Medicine, Universitas Indonesia, Jakarta, during 2018–2022.
METHODS A cross-sectional study was conducted to compare 5 years of data collected 
at  the  Clinical  Microbiology  Laboratory,  Faculty  of  Medicine,  Universitas  Indonesia.  
A  total  of  7,440  sputum  specimens  from  various  clinical  sites  were  examined  from  
2018  to  2022.  Sputum  specimens  from  TB  patients  were  prepared  for  microscopic  
examination using ZN staining to detect AFB. Culture and antimicrobial susceptibility 
of  TB  were  performed  on  LJ  agar.  Fungal  detected  on  microscopic  examination  and  
culture were assessed as coinfections.
RESULTS ZN staining to detect M. tuberculosis in clinical specimens has high specificity 
(98.4%) but low sensitivity (60.6%). Drug resistance in TB patients remains a problem, 
which can increase the risk of fungal infections. In 2018–2019, TB and fungal coinfections 
were more common in polyresistant TB cases. In 2020–2021, TB and fungal coinfections 
were found in all resistant TB cases, most commonly in XDR-TB cases. In 2022, TB and 
fungal  coinfections  were  found  in  monoresistant  and  polyresistant  patients.  Candida 
spp. was found in 6.2% of positive TB cases, and all were found in resistant TB.
CONCLUSIONS Increasing MDR- and XDR-TB are risk factors for fungal coinfection and 
must be detected early for better TB management in Indonesia.

Pulmonary   tuberculosis   (TB)   is   a   major   cause   
of    mortality    attributed    to    the    Mycobacterium 
tuberculosis complex, and is one of the top 10 global 
causes  of  death.
1,2
  Before  the  coronavirus  disease  
2019  (COVID-19)  pandemic,  efforts  to  combat  TB 
in  several  countries  were  relatively  stable.  This  is  
reflected in the 9% and 14% decrease in incidence and 
mortality,  respectively,  from  2015  to  2019.  According  
to  the  latest  2020  global  TB  report,  data  from  more  
than 200 countries showed a significant decline in 
TB case notifications. A 25–30% decline was reported 
between  January  and  June  2020  compared  with  the  
same  period  in  2019  in  three  high-burden  countries,  
including  Indonesia,  which  has  a  high  TB  burden  and  
limited diagnostic and therapeutic resources.
3
The Ministry of Health of the Republic of Indonesia 
compiled  a  roadmap  for  eradicating  TB  in  Indonesia  
from 2020 to 2030, including a target to reduce the 
incidence of TB to 65 cases per 100,000 people by 2030. 
In  Indonesia,  there  were  845,000  TB  cases  in  2019,  of

Of these cases, an estimated 24,000 were patients with 
drug-resistant  TB  (DR-TB),  with  an  enrollment  rate  of  
48% (5,531 patients) among 11,463 confirmed DR-TB 
cases.  This  remained  below  the  90%  treatment  target.  
Therefore,  this  falls  short  of  the  targets  required  to  
achieve TB elimination by 2030.
3,4
Long-term  treatment  of  TB  with  anti-TB  drugs,  
as   well   as   long-term   use   of   immunosuppressive   
agents or antibiotics, can lead to fungal infections. In 
patients  who  are  administered  anti-TB  medications  
in  the  presence  of  fungal  coinfection,  healing  may  
be prolonged. Bacteria can affect the growth and 
physiology  of  fungi;  however,  fungi  can  also  control  
bacterial    activity.    Various    Candida    species    are    
associated  with  pulmonary  TB  and  are  considered  
pathogenic   in   patients   with   TB.   The   coexistence   
of  pulmonary  TB  and  fungal  infection  can  affect 
treatment    and    increase    mortality    because    it    is    
challenging   to   distinguish   between   infection   and   
fungal  colonization.
5,6 
Therefore,  timely  diagnosis  of  
fungal  infection  in  patients  with  TB  is  essential  for  
treatment.  Studies  on  the  coexistence  of  fungi  and  
M.  tuberculosis  in  Indonesia  are  limited.  Therefore,  
this   study   aimed   to   evaluate   TB   and   coinfection   
with  pulmonary  fungal  pathogens  in  patients  with   
multidrug-resistant  (MDR)-TB  in  Indonesia  who  were  
referred to the Clinical Microbiology Laboratory, Faculty 
of Medicine, Universitas Indonesia, Jakarta, between 
2018 and 2022. Fungal coinfection in TB patients often 
occurs,  particularly  in  immunocompromised  patients  
with  MDR-TB.  This  finding  indicates  the  need  for 
comprehensive management that not only focuses on 
TB  bacteria  but  also  opportunistic  fungi  that  worsen  
the patient’s condition.
METHODS
This    cross-sectional    study    was    conducted    to    
compare  data  collected  over  a  5-year  period  (2018–
2022)  at  the  Clinical  Microbiology  Laboratory,  Faculty  
of   Medicine,   Universitas   Indonesia.   Samples   were   
collected   using   a   consecutive   sampling   method.   A   
total  of  7,440  sputum  specimens  from  various  clinical  
sites, examined between 2018 and 2022, were included 
in  this  study.  The  study  was  approved  by  the  Ethics  
Committee   of   the   Faculty   of   Medicine,   Universitas   
Indonesia  –  Cipto  Mangunkusumo  Hospital  (No:  KET-
683/UN2.F1/ETIK/PPM.00.02/2024).
Clinical specimens and microscopic examination
The   sputum   specimens   were   examined   at   the   
Clinical  Microbiology  Laboratory,  Faculty  of  Medicine,  
Universitas  Indonesia  to  confirm  the  diagnosis  of 
pulmonary  TB.  Ziehl-Neelsen  (ZN)  staining  was  used  
for   direct   examination   to   detect   acid-fast   bacilli   
(AFB).

Petroff’s method was used to process the specimens, 
which were then inoculated directly onto Lowenstein-
Jensen (LJ) agar for M. tuberculosis culture.

ABSTRACT
BACKGROUND Pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) is among the top 10 causes of death 
worldwide. Prolonged use and noncompliance with TB treatment have a potential risk 
for pulmonary fungal coinfection. This study aimed to evaluate fungal coinfection in 
pulmonary TB patients in Indonesia referred to the Clinical Microbiology Laboratory, 
Faculty of Medicine, Universitas Indonesia, Jakarta, during 2018–2022.
METHODS A cross-sectional study was conducted to compare 5 years of data collected 
at the Clinical Microbiology Laboratory, Faculty of Medicine, Universitas Indonesia. 
A total of 7,440 sputum specimens from various clinical sites were examined from 
2018 to 2022. Sputum specimens from TB patients were prepared for microscopic 
examination using ZN staining to detect AFB. Culture and antimicrobial susceptibility 
of TB were performed on LJ agar. Fungal detected on microscopic examination and 
culture were assessed as coinfections.

(98.4%) but low sensitivity (60.6%). Drug resistance in TB patients remains a problem, 
which can increase the risk of fungal infections. In 2018–2019, TB and fungal coinfections 
were more common in polyresistant TB cases. In 2020–2021, TB and fungal coinfections 
were found in all resistant TB cases, most commonly in XDR-TB cases. In 2022, TB and 
fungal coinfections were found in monoresistant and polyresistant patients. Candida
spp. was found in 6.2% of positive TB cases, and all were found in resistant TB.
CONCLUSIONS Increasing MDR- and XDR-TB are risk factors for fungal coinfection and 
must be detected early for better TB management in Indonesia.

ABSTRACT

BACKGROUND Pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) is among the top 10 causes of death worldwide. Prolonged use and noncompliance with TB treatment have a potential risk for pulmonary fungal coinfection. This study aimed to evaluate fungal coinfection in pulmonary TB patients in Indonesia referred to the Clinical Microbiology Laboratory, Faculty of Medicine, Universitas Indonesia, Jakarta, during 2018–2022.



METHODS A cross-sectional study was conducted to compare 5 years of data collected at the Clinical Microbiology Laboratory, Faculty of Medicine, Universitas Indonesia. A total of 7,440 sputum specimens from various clinical sites were examined from 2018 to 2022. Sputum specimens from TB patients were prepared for microscopic examination using ZN staining to detect AFB. Culture and antimicrobial susceptibility of TB were performed on LJ agar. Fungal detected on microscopic examination and culture were assessed as coinfections.



RESULTS ZN staining to detect M. tuberculosis in clinical specimens has high specificity (98.4%) but low sensitivity (60.6%). Drug resistance in TB patients remains a problem, which can increase the risk of fungal infections. In 2018–2019, TB and fungal coinfections were more common in polyresistant TB cases. In 2020–2021, TB and fungal coinfections were found in all resistant TB cases, most commonly in XDR-TB cases. In 2022, TB and fungal coinfections were found in monoresistant and polyresistant patients. Candida spp. was found in 6.2% of positive TB cases, and all were found in resistant TB.

Pulmonary tuberculosis (TB) is a major cause of mortality attributed to the Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex, and is one of the top 10 global causes of death.1,2 Before the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, efforts to combat TB in several countries were relatively stable. This is reflected in the 9% and 14% decrease in incidence and mortality, respectively, from 2015 to 2019. According to the latest 2020 global TB report, data from more than 200 countries showed a significant decline in

TB case notifications. A 25–30% decline was reported between January and June 2020 compared with the same period in 2019 in three high-burden countries, including Indonesia, which has a high TB burden and limited diagnostic and therapeutic resources.3

The Ministry of Health of the Republic of Indonesia compiled a roadmap for eradicating TB in Indonesia from 2020 to 2030, including a target to reduce the incidence of TB to 65 cases per 100,000 people by 2030. In Indonesia, there were 845,000 TB cases in 2019, of

Of these cases, an estimated 24,000 were patients with drug-resistant TB (DR-TB), with an enrollment rate of 48% (5,531 patients) among 11,463 confirmed DR-TB cases. This remained below the 90% treatment target. Therefore, this falls short of the targets required to achieve TB elimination by 2030.3,4

Long-term treatment of TB with anti-TB drugs, as well as long-term use of immunosuppressive agents or antibiotics, can lead to fungal infections. In patients who are administered anti-TB medications in the presence of fungal coinfection, healing may be prolonged. Bacteria can affect the growth and physiology of fungi; however, fungi can also control bacterial activity. Various Candida species are associated with pulmonary TB and are considered pathogenic in patients with TB. The coexistence of pulmonary TB and fungal infection can affect treatment and increase mortality because it is challenging to distinguish between infection and fungal colonization.5,6 Therefore, timely diagnosis of fungal infection in patients with TB is essential for treatment. Studies on the coexistence of fungi and

M. tuberculosis in Indonesia are limited. Therefore, this study aimed to evaluate TB and coinfection with pulmonary fungal pathogens in patients with multidrug-resistant (MDR)-TB in Indonesia who were referredtotheClinicalMicrobiologyLaboratory,Faculty of Medicine, Universitas Indonesia, Jakarta, between 2018 and 2022. Fungal coinfection in TB patients often occurs, particularly in immunocompromised patients with MDR-TB. This finding indicates the need for comprehensive management that not only focuses on TB bacteria but also opportunistic fungi that worsen the patient’s condition.



METHODS

This cross-sectional study was conducted to compare data collected over a 5-year period (2018–2022) at the Clinical Microbiology Laboratory, Faculty of Medicine, Universitas Indonesia. Samples were collected using a consecutive sampling method. A total of 7,440 sputum specimens from various clinical sites, examined between 2018 and 2022, were included in this study. The study was approved by the Ethics Committee of the Faculty of Medicine, Universitas Indonesia – Cipto Mangunkusumo Hospital (No: KET-683/UN2.F1/ETIK/PPM.00.02/2024).

Clinical specimens and microscopic examination

The sputum specimens were examined at the Clinical Microbiology Laboratory, Faculty of Medicine, Universitas Indonesia to confirm the diagnosis of pulmonary TB. Ziehl-Neelsen (ZN) staining was used for direct examination to detect acid-fast bacilli (AFB).7 Microscopic examination was performed both before and after decontamination. The digested and decontaminated specimens were mixed using a vortex and divided into two equal parts. The modified Petroff’s method was used to process the specimens, which were then inoculated directly onto Lowenstein-Jensen (LJ) agar for M. tuberculosis culture.8



Modified Petroff’s method

Approximately 3–5 ml of sputum and an equal volume of 4% sodium hydroxide (NaOH) were homogenized using a shaker for 15 min. The homogenized suspension was centrifuged at 3,000 g for 15–20 min. The pellet was then neutralized using 20 ml of sterile distilled water or aquadest pro injection. The specimen was re-centrifuged at 3,000 g for 15–20 min. The pellet was inoculated onto LJ slant agar and subjected to microscopic examination using ZN staining. Culture on LJ agar was incubated at 35–37°C.9 Where fungi were detected on microscopic examination, the culture was classified as a coinfection.



TB identification

knowledge.content_full:
TUGAS PENGGANTI UTS DATA MANAGEMENT

WAKTU	: 1 MINGGU

INSTRUKSI	:

Cari studi kasus untuk implementasi  PostgreSQL Full-Text Search (FTS). Studi kasus harus relevan dengan kondisi riil sehari-hari.

Cari dataset untuk studi kasus tersebut. Jangan lupa untuk menyertakan sumber nya di dalam laporan project.

Lakukan proses Tokenization dan Normalization (Lexemes, Stop words, Stemming).

Lakukan proses transformasi data teks menjadi tipe data tsvector dan menyimpannya secara efisien.

Rancang strategi Ranking dan Highlighting untuk menyajikan data yang relevan.

Lakukan analisis performa query dan mengimplementasikan indeks khusus (GIN vs GiST) untuk optimasi Data Management.

Implementasi untuk pencarian data fulltext Advanced Querying & Relevance Ranking

Tahap pertama mengumpulkan tugas hari ini dalam bentuk laporan awal. Di dalam laporan harus memuat:

Penjelasan studi kasus yang diangkat

Manfaat dari implementasi tersebut di dalam data management

Data set dan implementasi awal

knowledge_candidates.question_text: Bagaimana meredakan nyeri otot kram setelah berolahraga berat?
